title: An AI-for-good CEO is putting a mission lock in — and her investor is helping write it
summary: Egan co-founded and runs ecomedes, which makes the environmental impact of building materials transparent. On a San Francisco Chamber of Commerce panel about how missions outlive their management teams, she said the company is working on a mission lock and named the investor helping with it.
blockquote: ecomedes is exploring "mission lock" as recommended by Eric.  Do investors like this?  Well, one of our largest investors, Jack McMackin from Mission Innovation Network is the one helping us work on it, so yes that seems to be the case.
